title: Fix canonical review audit event chronology across rotations

owned: Canonical review audit event chronology across active and rotated logs

not_changing: Activity log rotation or archive naming

failure_reproduction.pr_5527: A 13:48 assign event in a lexically later content-addressed archive was scanned after a 15:18 exact-head approval and incorrectly revoked it.
failure_reproduction.root_cause: Archive filename order was treated as event chronology even though rotation filenames are content hashes.

implementation.chronology_authority: .orchestrator/common.py stream_logical_activity logical append order; archive filenames and event timestamps carry no independent ordering authority.
fail_closed_conditions: invalid rotation lineage or source identity
implementation.consumer_unification: Standalone canonical review checks and auto-integrator ReviewGate call the same load_approval_record function, which delegates production audit replay to stream_logical_activity. Injected fixture events retain caller order.
